verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It verifies that conjugacy classes are the orbits of the conjugation action, proves that each class has size [G:C_G(x)], shows every non-singleton class size is divisible by p, and applies the class equation to conclude that p divides |Z(G)|. Since the center contains the identity and has at least p elements, it contains a nonidentity element. The hypotheses are used appropriately, and there are no external references, unsupported fact citations, hard-prohibition violations, logical errors, or gaps.
